title: Find a Line · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Find a Line · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a line direction, such as horizontal or vertical. The lead identifies three separate visible objects with an edge in that direction. The group can see the matching edges. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Find a Line, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group can see the matching edges.
recall.why: The group can see the matching edges.
